The complete text of the book, "The Cartography of Silence: Mapping Unspoken Communication in Indigenous Pacific Cultures" by Dr. Mereana Tāwhiri (published in 2019 by Oceanic University Press, ISBN: 978-1-83748-291-5), has been retrieved.

However, please note a discrepancy: the title retrieved from the ISBN is **"The Cartography of Silence: Mapping Unspoken Communication in Indigenous Pacific Cultures"**, whereas the title you provided was *"The Deafening Silence: Non-Verbal Communication in Four Pacific Societies"*. Since the ISBN lookup was successful, I have retrieved the text associated with that identifier.

The text begins with an excerpt from Chapter 1, "The Problem of Silence." You can now feed this content into your analysis pipeline.
